title: Responses interop bridge: translation spec, gap catalog, and runtime fallbacks
creator: Aisha Ramirez
description: Objective: Produce a single canonical translation layer spec plus a running gap catalog that maps the OpenAI Responses API semantics to Redwood's Responses-compatible surface and runtime behaviors. Deliverables: (1) Confluence spec describing event-by-event streaming mapping, function/tool-call lifecycle, structured output schema translation, and error/truncation semantics; (2) a JSON "canonical_mapping.json" in runtime repo for use by the responses-compat shim; (3) a canary rollout plan (metrics + fallback) and end-to-end test harness; (4) prioritized gap catalog with suggested runtime mitigations and UX notes for SDKs and Console.
comments: 2025-02-18 | Aisha Ramirez: Ticket created after spike with DEV and PM. Scope includes streaming token-by-token mapping, function-invocation boundary semantics, structured-output schema enforcement, and runtime fallbacks for missing features.

2025-02-21 | Lars O'Neill: Prototype translator implemented that converts Redwood 'delta' stream events to an OpenAI-style 'chunk' envelope. Initial tests reveal differences in partial function call signaling (Redwood emits tool metadata at call completion; OpenAI sometimes includes a preliminary 'name' field mid-stream).

2025-02-25 | Priya Desai (PM): Reviewed early spec. Key asks: (a) clearly document user-visible behavioral diffs; (b) propose migration helpers for SDKs; (c) emphasize SLO/latency tradeoffs for buffering to ensure atomic function-call events.
2025-02-27 | Design review (Marta Kovacs): UI impact noted for Console streaming inspector — need to display 'bridged' vs 'native' events and flag where structured-output was normalized.

2025-03-01 | Lars O'Neill: Added gap catalog section for mismatched error modes (OpenAI uses HTTP 400 for invalid function-return, Redwood currently emits an internal event + 200). Proposed runtime fallback: opaque passthrough with a compatibility header to preserve original behavior while we roll out stricter handling.

2025-03-04 | SRE (Jon Kim): Canary probes added to Grafana dashboard. Watchlist: increased p95 latency due to buffering (if we batch deltas into OpenAI-style chunks), and memory growth for long-running streaming sessions. Action: add autosweep for idle streams.
2025-03-05 | Aisha Ramirez: Merged canonical mapping draft into runtime repo as a WIP; opened follow-ups for unit tests and SDK helpers.

2025-03-05 | Lars O'Neill: Note — tokenization mismatch tests show ~0.5% of test prompts produce off-by-one differences in function trigger positions; added a migration note recommending a small prompt shim for customers relying on exact offsets.
